clue.text: Tobit strays to abode of hermit, one Sandro

indicators.note: letters that stray wander out of their places, so the name is rearranged

parts.note: a hermit lives in a small bare cell
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: The Apocryphal Tobit wanders off to a hermit's cell, where a certain Sandro lives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strays' rearranges TOBIT into BOTTI; 'one' is the Roman numeral, not part of the name.
explanation.definitionFit: Sandro Botticelli was the Florentine Renaissance painter of The Birth of Venus.

clue.text: Native in bed may be caught by a bird

definitions.text: Native in bed may be caught by a bird

parts.words: Native in bed may be caught by a bird
parts.note: a native is a cultivated shellfish lying in its bed on the sea floor, prey to the wading bird named for catching it

explanation.surface: A local person asleep in bed might be snatched by a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A native is an English farmed bivalve from a bed, and the oystercatcher is a shore bird that eats them.

clue.text: Insert spring in lock for ': unlawful, entry

indicators.note: insert says one piece is put into another
in shows where the spring is placed, within the lock

parts.note: a lock of hair is a tress
a spa is a mineral spring

explanation.surface: A burglar fits a spring into a lock to break in.
explanation.definitionFit: Trespass is going on to land without the right to, an illegal intrusion.

clue.text: Make firewood out of 'the old: piano'?

definitions.meaning: to cut wood into kindling, to split logs
a simple, much-mocked tune that beginners play on the piano

explanation.surface: Chop up an antique piano for kindling?
explanation.definitionFit: To chop sticks is to make kindling, and the famous two-finger piano waltz bears that name.

clue.text: No time for' a gentleman to, be marking a quarter

definitions.text: No time for' a gentleman to, be marking a quarter

parts.words: No time for' a gentleman to, be marking a quarter
parts.note: a day said to belong to a woman rather than a man, which marks one of the quarter days of the year

explanation.surface: A man has no time to keep track of a quarter.
explanation.walkthrough: In England, 25 March, the Feast of the Annunciation, is one of the four quarter days when rents fell due.
explanation.definitionFit: The Feast of the Annunciation honours the Virgin Mary and was an English quarter day.

clue.text: Form of worship the same in the Italian style

indicators.note: in puts the ditto mark inside the Italian article

parts.note: il is the Italian for the
do is short for ditto, meaning the same

explanation.surface: A form of worship carried out identically in Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: An idol is an image worshipped, the object of devotion.

clue.text: Vacate it, in order to, start working

indicators.note: putting the letters in order means arranging them afresh

explanation.surface: Instruction to leave a building so work can begin.
explanation.definitionFit: To activate something is to set it going, to make it operate.

clue.text: But the poor little chap's no oil-king buying up Piccadilly

definitions.text: But the poor little chap's no oil-king buying up Piccadilly

parts.words: But the poor little chap's no oil-king buying up Piccadilly
parts.note: a homeless urchin, in name a road plus a man from the Gulf, though no oil sheikh buying up London's famous road

explanation.surface: A poor child is not a wealthy sheikh snapping up London property.
explanation.walkthrough: Piccadilly is a famous London thoroughfare, so it stands for a road, and an oil-king is a rich Arab.
explanation.definitionFit: The dated term described a homeless child living rough on city roads.

clue.text: Melodious if uninspired group, say?

indicators.note: say asks us to speak the words and listen to what they sound like

parts.note: uninspired means dull, and a group is a set

explanation.surface: Can a band with no inspiration still make sweet music?
explanation.walkthrough: DULL SET spoken quickly sounds like the adjective for sweet-toned.
explanation.definitionFit: Dulcet tones are sweet and pleasant to hear, so the word is a synonym of tuneful.

clue.text: Heavenly body of whose dynamics Moriarty wrote

definitions.meaning: a small rocky body orbiting the sun
Sherlock Holmes's enemy Professor Moriarty wrote The Dynamics of an ...

explanation.surface: A celestial object that was the subject of a treatise by Holmes's great foe.
explanation.definitionFit: A minor planet is a heavenly body, and Conan Doyle credits Moriarty with a book on the dynamics of one.

clue.text: Time for duel with an abominable snowman perhaps

indicators.note: perhaps hints that the pooled letters may be arranged some other way

parts.note: the abominable snowman of the Himalayas is the yeti

explanation.surface: A fight with a yeti in the snow is the seasonal entertainment.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of DUEL and YETI together rearrange into the festive season.
explanation.definitionFit: Yuletide is the Christmas season, a period of the year.

clue.text: Region sounds more ethereal

indicators.note: sounds says the word we want is heard like another word

parts.note: more ethereal, lighter and airy, is airier

explanation.surface: A district that seems more otherworldly than the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A region is a tract of land or a district, a synonym.

clue.text: Not on purpose, :note

definitions.meaning: in music, a sharp, flat or natural sign outside the key

explanation.surface: A note to say it was not intended.
explanation.definitionFit: An unplanned event is by chance, and in notation a sharp or flat outside the key signature carries the same name.

clue.text: Lost your heart? So get reorganized

definitions.text: Lost your heart? So get reorganized

parts.words: Lost your heart? So get reorganized
parts.note: losing one's heart sounds like falling in love, but read literally a missing heart is replaced by surgery that reorganizes the body

explanation.surface: Advice to someone who has fallen in love: pull yourself together.
explanation.definitionFit: A heart operation of this kind gives a patient a new organ in place of the lost one.

clue.text: Chef's made a mistake — how does he look ?

indicators.note: a mistake jumbles things, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken with its S as letters

explanation.surface: A cook has erred; what expression is on his face?
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of CHEFS MADE A rearrange into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone embarrassed by an error looks abashed and guilty.

clue.text: Horseman Bird astride a donkey back to front

indicators.note: astride means straddling, so the bird's letters sit on either side

parts.note: a cock is a male bird

indicators.note: back to front tells us to read the donkey's letters in the opposite order

parts.note: a donkey is an ass

explanation.surface: A rider and his bird are seated the wrong way round on a donkey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bird' looks like a second horseman's name, but it is the outer piece; 'back to front' turns the donkey round before the bird straddles it.
explanation.definitionFit: Cossacks were famed cavalrymen of the Russian steppes.

clue.text: It's almost half the compound, and half the year of course

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the last letter goes

parts.note: semi is a prefix meaning half
an ester is a chemical compound of an acid and alcohol

explanation.surface: A chemistry student notes that a certain compound takes up nearly half his year.
explanation.walkthrough: SEMI with its last letter dropped gives SEM.
explanation.definitionFit: In a college with two terms a year, each is half the academic year.

clue.text: Louis. ended 'way back in Paris '

parts.note: something ended is over and past

indicators.note: back tells us to read the French street word in reverse

parts.note: rue is French for a street, a way, as 'in Paris' signals

explanation.surface: A Frenchman named Louis came to the end of the road back home in Paris.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in Paris' says the way is a French one, RUE, which 'back' turns into EUR.
explanation.definitionFit: Louis Pasteur was the French chemist behind pasteurisation and vaccines.

clue.text: A North African cask is one article

parts.note: a tun is a large cask for wine or beer
the Roman numeral for one is I
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: In a North African market a barrel counts as a single item.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Tunisia, a country on the Mediterranean coast of North Africa.

clue.text: What a' mouldy, sort of surgery:!

definitions.meaning: cosmetic or reconstructive surgery to reshape the body

explanation.surface: An exclamation at a mouldy kind of operation.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means mouldable or pliable, and reshaping surgery bears the same adjective.

clue.text: Old Miss Crane

definitions.meaning: an archaic word for a young unmarried lady
the name of a small crane of Asia and Africa

explanation.surface: An elderly spinster called Miss Crane.
explanation.definitionFit: The French-derived word once meant a damsel, and the demoiselle crane is a bird species.

clue.text: Senseless, opening a pentateuchal book

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its start, so only the front of the book's name is kept

parts.note: Numbers is the fourth of the five books of Moses

explanation.surface: Someone opens one of the first five books of the Bible and finds it meaningless.
explanation.walkthrough: The Pentateuch is the first five books of the Old Testament; only the start of NUMBERS is used.
explanation.definitionFit: Numb means without feeling, deprived of sensation.

clue.text: A gala May opening up here in Spain

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the letters are read from bottom to top
opening up the words exposes a run of letters inside them

explanation.surface: A gala in May launches the festivities in a Spanish town.
explanation.walkthrough: Inside 'A gala May' lies AGALAM, which read backwards gives the city.
explanation.definitionFit: Malaga is a port city on Spain's Costa del Sol.

clue.text: Individual airways

parts.note: it reads like the name of an airline, but means the private air passages of one person

explanation.surface: The name of a small private airline.
explanation.definitionFit: Each person breathes through these two openings of the nose, passages for air.

clue.text: It looks a mite odd on the agenda

definitions.note: a thing on the agenda, one point in a list

indicators.note: odd means strange, so the letters are shaken into a new form

explanation.surface: Something on a meeting's agenda seems slightly strange.
explanation.definitionFit: Each point listed in an agenda is called an entry of that kind.

clue.text: Such military plans need Savoir-faire, I state

parts.note: savoir-faire, social skill, is tact
CAL is an abbreviation for California, a US state

explanation.surface: A general declares that his strategies call for finesse.
explanation.definitionFit: Tactical describes plans for the conduct of a battle rather than a whole war.

clue.text: Way, to a rendezvous

parts.note: a rendezvous is a meeting place, a venue

explanation.surface: Directions on how to get to a meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: An avenue is a broad road, a way or route.

clue.text: Alexander, for instance, came adrift with fellow Scot

indicators.note: adrift means loose and out of place, so the letters are reordered

parts.note: a don is a fellow of a university college
Ian is a typically Scottish first name

explanation.surface: Alexander drifted into port with a Scottish companion.
explanation.definitionFit: Alexander the Great was king of Macedon, so he is an example of a man from there.
